summary: Backend-only testing of new GET /api/feed/live endpoint and regression on /api/posts*. Created /app/backend/tests/test_live_feed_api.py with 21 integration tests against the live preview URL and re-ran the existing 9 unit tests in test_live_feed.py. All 30/30 tests PASS. Auth is enforced (403 without token, 401-equivalent for bad token), response shape ({stats:{sessions_today:int, most_common_mood:str|null}, entries:[]}) is correct, every entry has all required fields (id/type/user/mood_bucket/mood_label/workout_name/duration_minutes/milestone_count/timestamp/ago_text), mood_bucket only contains the 6 valid buckets, type only contains live_now/completion/milestone, ago_text is always relative (no absolute dates), entries are sorted by timestamp DESC, limit param is respected, no raw mongo _id leaks, and neighbouring routes (/api/posts, /api/posts/public, /api/posts/following) still respond.

minor.issue: Live preview DB has no recent (<20min) workout_started events and no users at milestone counts {5,10,25,50,100,...}, so live_now and milestone entry types could not be exercised against real data; only completion type was observed. Type-specific assertions still pass conditionally. Recommend seeding a recent workout_started event + a user with workouts_count=5 for full coverage in future runs.

On the preview environment all 30 returned entries had ago_text='earlier' because the lookback widened to 365 days to reach the 15-entry minimum. Functionally correct per spec ('stretch lookback invisibly'), but indicates the dataset is stale — frontend will show 30 'earlier' cards which may not feel 'live'.

action_items: (Optional) Seed a fresh workout_started event (<20min old) and a user with workouts_count in {5,10,25,50,100} so live_now and milestone entry types can be observed end-to-end in the preview env.

(Optional) Consider whether the 365-day lookback fallback should still apply when the result will only contain very stale 'earlier' entries — possibly cap fallback at e.g. 30 days and return whatever exists rather than padding to 15 with stale data.
critical_code_review_comments: _LIVE_MOOD_RULES ordering: 'pull' keyword in calisthenics rule may incorrectly classify generic 'pull-day' weight workouts as calisthenics if they don't contain 'muscle gainer'/'back'/etc; acceptable but worth noting.

milestone branch reads user_doc['workouts_count'] but only emits an entry when wcount EXACTLY matches a threshold ({5,10,...}). Users sitting at e.g. 6 workouts (one past a milestone) will never produce a milestone card — by design but easy to overlook.
No pagination/skip param — limit only. Acceptable for a Live tab but worth documenting.
user_cache lookups skip uids whose len != 24 (non-ObjectId users). OAuth/custom-id users with `user_id` field instead of ObjectId _id will be silently filtered out of the feed.
server.py is 12,829 lines — well past the 700-line guideline. Recommend extracting feed/live logic into a dedicated module (feed_live.py) along with its helpers and bucket maps.

success_rate.frontend: not tested (skipped per request — React Native/Expo app)

It mints a JWT for officialmoodapp using JWT_SECRET in backend/.env and validates every requirement from the review request. test_live_feed.py covers helper-level mood classification + relative time formatting.
